steps: Attach the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Check the logical machine assignment of the X and A axes
If the axes are not detachable, consult the system documentation for axis detachment procedures
If the axes are already linked by Electronic Cam, ensure they are
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the current logical machine attachment of the x' axis
Use the attach command to assign the x' axis to logical machine 1
Verify the x' axis is now attached to logical machine 1
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the configured search hierarchy folders.
Check the search hierarchy path settings to ensure they are correctly defined.
Restart the CNC system to apply any changes to the search hierarchy.
Add at least 3 control points between `splineon` and `splineoff` commands.
Check the spline type and ensure control points are evenly spaced for uniform splines.
Verify the `splineon` and `splineoff` blocks are correctly placed in the program.
Edit the program to ensure only one class 1 preparatory word is used per block.
Check the block for multiple class 1 preparatory words and remove any excess.
Check the joint logical device settings to ensure logical device 5 is assigned to only one joint.
Verify the logical device number 5 is uniquely mapped in the Joint logical device parameter.
If the logical device 5 is already correctly mapped, reinitialise the configuration.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license status to confirm the OPC UA server option is not included.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if needed.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
If the Master state changed, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
If the error is informational, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system
Verify the cyclic task configuration for task 1
Check the drive's reported error register
If multiple errors continue, perform a system restart
Upload firmware to device Drive_3
Start AMCore in device mode
Verify firmware version of Drive_3
Check the fieldbus state is PREOP
If the fieldbus is in operational mode, stop AMCore
